equivalenceOn_urel.statement: (Lemma 5.4.2) Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a$ be a natural number, $q$ a real number, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$ a function, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ functions and $F, G \subseteq X$ subsets. Assume an instance of the project structure `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (per its docstring, the data common through most of chapters 2-7); through its `KernelProofData` component it equips $X$ with a doubling-measure structure `DoublingMeasure X (2^a)` and with compatible functions `CompatibleFunctions ℝ X (2^a)` (hence a `FunctionDistances ℝ X` structure with its type $\Theta(X)$ of functions), and it provides $Q$ (`ProofData.Q`), a simple function from $X$ to $\Theta(X)$. Assume moreover a tile structure `TileStructure Q D κ S o` with $D = $ `defaultD a` $= 2^{𝕔 a^2}$ (where $𝕔$ is the project's fixed natural-number constant `𝕔`), $\kappa = $ `defaultκ a` $= 2^{-10a}$, $S = $ `defaultS X` (the least positive natural number $n$ such that $-n\le\sigma_1(x)$ and $\sigma_2(x)\le n$ for all $x\in X$ and $F$ and $G$ are contained in the open ball of radius $D^n/4$ about $o$) and $o = $ `cancelPt X` (a chosen point of $X$ at which every function of $\Theta(X)$ vanishes). Write $\mathfrak{P}$ for the type `𝔓 X` of tiles of this tile structure; each tile $p$ has a grid cube $\mathcal I(p)$ (`𝓘 p`), a point $\mathfrak c(p)=c(\mathcal I(p))\in X$ and an integer $\mathfrak s(p)=s(\mathcal I(p))$ (given by the grid-structure fields `c` and `s` applied to the cube $\mathcal I(p)$), and a function $\mathcal Q(p)\in\Theta(X)$ (`𝒬 p`). For a real $l$ and a tile $p$, `smul l p` is the pair $(\mathcal I(p),\ B_p(\mathcal Q(p), l))$ in the project type `TileLike X` (the product of the grid cubes with the order dual of the sets of elements of $\Theta(X)$), where $B_p(\mathcal Q(p),l)$ is the ball of radius $l$ around $\mathcal Q(p)$ in $\Theta(X)$ for the function-distance pseudometric attached to the point $\mathfrak c(p)$ and radius $D^{\mathfrak s(p)}/4$; `smul l p ≤ smul l' p'` refers to the project's partial order on `TileLike X`. Let $k, n, j$ be natural numbers. For a tile $u$, $\mathfrak T_1(k,n,j,u)$ (`𝔗₁ k n j u`) is the set of tiles $p$ in the project set $\mathfrak C_1(k,n,j)$ (`ℭ₁ k n j`) with $\mathcal I(p)\ne\mathcal I(u)$ and `smul 2 p ≤ smul 1 u`. Let $\mathfrak{U}_2(k,n,j) \subseteq \mathfrak{P}$ be the project set `𝔘₂ k n j` (per its docstring, the subset of $\mathfrak U_1(k,n,j)$ given in (5.4.2)). Let $\sim$ be the project relation `URel k n j` on $\mathfrak{P}$, whose definition body is: $u \sim u'$ iff $u = u'$ or there is $p \in \mathfrak{T}_1(k,n,j,u)$ with `smul 10 p ≤ smul 1 u'`. Then $\sim$ is an equivalence relation on the set $\mathfrak{U}_2(k,n,j)$ (the project predicate `EquivalenceOn (URel k n j) (𝔘₂ k n j)`, per its docstring: an equivalence relation on the set).
